scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck:tests && tsc -p packages/runner-web/tsconfig.app.json
scripts.fixtures:author: node tools/fixtures/author/generate.mjs
scripts.oracle:check: python3 tools/fixtures/reference/render.py --check && node tools/fixtures/author/generate.mjs --check && pnpm run saveload:check && pnpm run audio-protocol:check && pnpm run runner-protocol:check
scripts.golden:bun: pnpm build && bun packages/runner-headless/dist/cli.js golden && bun packages/runner-headless/dist/cli.js closing
scripts.dump:check: tsc -b && node packages/runner-headless/dist/cli.js dump --check golden/legacy-corpus.json fixtures/legacy && node packages/runner-headless/dist/cli.js dump --check golden/spec-examples.json docs/spec/examples
scripts.dump:record: tsc -b && node packages/runner-headless/dist/cli.js dump --record golden/legacy-corpus.json fixtures/legacy
scripts.dump:check:examples: tsc -b && node packages/runner-headless/dist/cli.js dump --check golden/spec-examples.json docs/spec/examples
scripts.dump:record:examples: tsc -b && node packages/runner-headless/dist/cli.js dump --record golden/spec-examples.json docs/spec/examples
